answer: An agent market requires each identity to lock 100 tokens for 30 days before receiving a daily job quota; agents named raven, nebula and zephyr face the same rule. Creating 1,000 fake identities therefore ties up 100,000 tokens for a month, making quota farming costly even if accounts are free. If an agent signs two conflicting receipts for the same job, anyone can submit both signatures to slash its bond.
